_comment: Append-only ledger of every build uploaded to App Store Connect. One row per (version, build). The archive script (ios/tools/testflight_archive.sh) records a row automatically on SGGS_UPLOAD=1; a Transporter upload is recorded with `testflight_ledger.py record --force`. Apple rejects a reused CFBundleVersion for a marketing version, and a marketing version lower than one already on TestFlight, so `testflight_ledger.py check` gates both before an archive runs. Build numbers are per marketing version and only go up.
